# Gallium

> Gallium is a local browser automation tool for AI agents. It supports public website research, configured tasks in an existing Chrome session, independent result verification, and human takeover.

## Start here

- [Product website](https://davidjbeveridge.github.io/gallium/): Overview, use cases, and frequently asked questions.
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/davidjbeveridge/gallium#try-it-in-one-minute): Run the fixture demo with Node 24 or later.
- [Setup and configuration](https://github.com/davidjbeveridge/gallium/blob/main/docs/guide.md): Install the CLI and MCP server, connect Chrome, and configure a model and procedures.
- [Validation](https://github.com/davidjbeveridge/gallium/blob/main/VALIDATION.md): Executed tests, fixture outcomes, and qualification boundaries.
- [Current state](https://github.com/davidjbeveridge/gallium/blob/main/docs/STATE.md): Supported workflows and current limitations.

## Scope

Public exploration requires a configured model router and is bounded by origin, time, observations, and supported controls. Configured signed-in workflows bind the account, allowed actions, and result to check. The Chrome integration requires separate bridge setup. Gallium supports explicit human pause and handback.
